answer: Verified-work ledger. Each identity's voting weight is a delta of independently checkable task receipts signed by requesters, so fake accounts earn zero weight until real counterparties confirm completed work. A bridge identity must accumulate genuine cross-party endorsements under distinct requester keys, which a single operator cannot fabricate without controlling those parties. At each dawn settlement, unconfirmed weight decays to zero and re-verification costs the attacker fresh coordination with independent requesters per identity.
